notes.title: Patch Note 0.0.5
notes.notes:
1.Added the skill and skill icon of flying dragon, and used the second skill in the middle of the mouse.
2.Updated the flying dragon death effect.
3.Increased the time limit of the game, 15 minutes per game.
4.If you have steam friends, the AI displays the name of the friend.
5.Increased the screen effect of player being hit.

notes.title: Patch Note 0.03
notes.notes:
1.Increased the attack power of all flying dragons.
2.Increased the mana recovery speed of all flying dragons.
3.Add a enemy tracking function use “H” to open it or close it.
4.Updated new scoreboard,use “Tab” to open it or close it.
5.Updated death effects.
6.The fireball tracking function is added to make it easy for the fireball to hit the target.
